title: The Things I Do with the Lonely Girl’s in her Room
description: It’s a secret routine shared only between the two of them, Kotori, a beautiful girl admired by her classmates as the “Lonely Ice Princess,” and Takumi, a quiet, introverted loner, never interact in the classroom. But after school, in Kotori’s room, they engage in acts that go beyond those of an ordinary couple. They only loosen their clothes as much as necessary and connect physically in a mechanical way, without kisses or even exchanging words, this act is a routine Kotori created to change her own introverted self, one day, Kotori is helped out of a difficult situation by Akira, an upperclassman in her second year. Cute, cheerful, and kind to everyone, Akira is the very embodiment of the person Kotori admires, Determined to become someone like Akira, Kotori continues her routine with Takumi, taking one step at a time toward becoming the person she wants to be, a story about a secret relationship where two awkward teenagers fumble their way through the experience of youth together!
author: Hibari Yu
